appDescription: A pickup companion that agrees on the best meeting point with a waiting family member and confirms when they board the car.

function.name: START_PICKUP
function.description: Start picking up a registered family member and share a meeting point link with them.

memberName.description: Name of the family member to pick up.

function.name: FIND_NEARBY
function.description: Find a nearby place during a pickup: a parking lot near the meeting point, the nearest public restroom, a drive-thru, or a takeout spot on the way that fits the time before the family member comes out; offer navigation and a voice order.
